    Plot Bayesian flood quantile curves using base R graphics

    plot.curve.Rd

    Produces a log-log return period plot showing posterior mean curves, credibility intervals, and observed plotting positions.

    # S3 method for class 'curve'
plot(
  analysis,
  T.start = 1.01,
  T.end = 1000,
  plotting.formula = 0.44,
  add = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    analysis

    A result list returned by perform.analysis().

    T.start

    Minimum return period for the curve (default = 1.01).

    T.end

    Maximum return period for the curve (default = 1000).

    plotting.formula

    Plotting-position constant(s) for observed points (default = 0.44).

    add

    Logical. If TRUE, adds curves to an existing plot (default = FALSE).

    Value

    A base R plot is produced as a side effect.
